Class ShipBuildingState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.ShipBuildingState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
SecondShipBuildingState, TestShipBuildingState
public abstract sealed class ShipBuildingState extends GameState permits SecondShipBuildingState, TestShipBuildingState
Abstract base class for ship building states in the Galaxy Truckers game. This class represents the phase where players build their ships by selecting, placing, and arranging components. It manages the component bank and tracks the status of ship construction.

The class is sealed to restrict subclassing to specific ship building states.

      public boolean componentInHand()
